rank_note: Customer bands are estimates. They are never used to rank.

ach.operator_fee_sentence: FedACH 2026 origination item fee, forward or return, billing codes 57201, 57202, 57205, 57211, 57212, 57215: $0.0035. Effective January 1, 2026. Volume discounts and the monthly minimum are not allocated to one payment.

customer_fee_band_usd.label: estimate
customer_fee_band_usd.note: Not a tariff and not used to rank.

same_day_ach.operator_fee_sentence: FedACH 2026 forward item fee $0.0035 plus SameDay Service forward-item surcharge billing code 57620 $0.0010. Effective January 1, 2026.

customer_fee_band_usd.label: estimate
customer_fee_band_usd.note: Not a tariff and not used to rank.

fedwire.operator_fee_sentence: Fedwire Funds Service 2026 tier-1 pre-incentive per-transfer price $0.97 for monthly volume up to 14,000. Effective January 1, 2026. Volume incentive prices and any surcharge on transfers processed after 5:00 p.m. ET are not included.

customer_fee_band_usd.label: estimate
customer_fee_band_usd.note: Not a tariff and not used to rank. Bank retail wire prices are far above the Fed's per-transfer fee.

rtp.operator_fee_sentence: The Clearing House does not publish one public per-payment operator price. RTP is shown for speed and is excluded from the cost rank.

customer_fee_band_usd.label: estimate
customer_fee_band_usd.note: Not a tariff and not used to rank.

fednow.operator_fee_sentence: FedNow 2026 customer credit transfer pacs.008 origination, billing code 81100: $0.045 per item. Effective January 1, 2026. A 2026 discount zeros that fee for up to 2,500 originations a month. The rank uses the list price, not the discount.

customer_fee_band_usd.label: estimate
customer_fee_band_usd.note: Not a tariff and not used to rank.
